mutations.name: Quick reset
mutations.description: Hold 5 minutes, then exit.

mutations.name: Short pause
mutations.description: Hold 15 minutes, then exit.

mutations.name: Half-hour reset
mutations.description: Hold 30 minutes, then exit.

mutations.name: One-hour recovery window
mutations.description: Hold 1 hour, then exit.

mutations.name: Two-hour recovery window
mutations.description: Hold 2 hours, then exit.

mutations.name: Patient four-hour window
mutations.description: Hold 4 hours, then exit.

mutations.name: Extended six-hour window
mutations.description: Hold 6 hours, then exit.

mutations.name: Scratch after fees
mutations.description: Exit when the complete position can break even after fees; otherwise 6 hours.

mutations.name: Recover one quarter
mutations.description: Exit after recovering 25% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 4 hours.

mutations.name: Recover one half
mutations.description: Exit after recovering 50% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 4 hours.

mutations.name: Recover three quarters
mutations.description: Exit after recovering 75% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 6 hours.

mutations.name: Relax the recovery target
mutations.description: Require 75% recovery in hour 1, 50% in hour 2, then 25%; exit by 4 hours.

mutations.name: Confirm the recovery
mutations.description: Require 50% recovery on at least 3 distinct books spanning 60 seconds; exit by 4 hours. Gaps reset confirmation.

mutations.name: Protect a rebound
mutations.description: Arm after 50% recovery; exit if loss worsens from its best by 25% of initial loss. Exit by 6 hours.

mutations.name: Scratch or cut deterioration
mutations.description: Exit at break-even or when loss reaches 150% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 2 hours.

mutations.name: Leave a stalled recovery
mutations.description: Exit after 1 continuously observed hour without an improvement of at least 5% of initial loss; otherwise 4 hours. Gaps reset the stall clock.

mutations.name: Exit a fading rebound
mutations.description: After 50% recovery, exit on 3 consecutive worsening fresh books; otherwise 4 hours. Gaps reset the sequence.

mutations.name: Halve risk, then recover
mutations.description: Sell half immediately. Exit the rest when combined loss is at most 50% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 4 hours.

mutations.name: Four-step exit
mutations.description: Sell cumulative 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% at 15, 30, 60, 120 minutes, limited by available depth.

mutations.name: Cap the reward sacrifice
mutations.description: Exit after 50% recovery or when missed rewards reach 25% of the initial loss; otherwise 4 hours. Unknown rewards cannot trigger the budget rule.

trigger: Every farming fill leaving unpaired inventory
